## Source 1 — 生成引擎优化 (GEO):品牌口碑营销的未来发展方向 (CSDN / feibai110, 2026)

**Type:** Industry primer (CSDN 中文 GEO 框架)
**Headline:** "生成引擎优化(GEO) — 通过优化内容结构、语义关联及技术适配,使品牌信息被 GE 优先引用为答案的 AI 时代营销策略"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "(Statista 预测,2025 年全球生成式 AI 搜索流量将占搜索总量的 35%)"
> "从链接列表到答案生成:GE(如 ChatGPT、DeepSeek)直接提供定制化答案,覆盖文本、图像、视频。"
> "84% 的用户更倾向于通过自然语言提问获取答案而非传统搜索"

> "GEO 四大核心战略:让品牌'被 AI 选中' — AI 语言适配、多模态内容矩阵、结构化文本、视觉增强"

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- 35% 生成式搜索 = 1/3 of all search by 2025
- 84% 用户偏自然语言提问 = the named-anchor behavioral shift
- 89% AI 答案来自 EEAT ≥ 80 = the named-anchor authority threshold

### Why this works:
**The "35% by 2025" stat is fresh vs the persona's pinned "25% by 2028" anchor.** 35% > 25% = the threat has arrived faster than Gartner projected. The 89% EEAT threshold is the named-anchor authority gate. The Scribe should hold "35% by 2025" + "89% from EEAT ≥ 80" — both are load-bearing facts. **Pair with Source 2 (Sagefrog English primer) for cross-language validation of the same thesis.**

- **Sources 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 form the English-language discipline ecosystem.** Sagefrog (Source 2) = primer; Digital Applied (Source 3) = taxonomy; Evergreen Media (Source 4) = AEO sibling; Scrunch (Source 5) = tooling. The Scribe should pick 2 of 4.
- **The "GEO ≠ SEO ≠ AEO" taxonomy (Source 3) is the load-bearing conceptual frame.** The Scribe should use this to position GEO as a separate discipline, not an SEO extension.

ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot. They don't show your link. They cite your source. 89% of AI answers come from EEAT ≥ 80 sites. Build the GEO stack. Schema. Author entities. Citation density."
